config.description: A senior and staff level LLMOps interview curriculum: 20 modules covering serving, retrieval, evaluation, agents, security, release engineering, governance and system-design practice, with runnable code.
config.footerNote: Open-source learning project. Code samples are syntax-checked; library calls may drift between versions, so verify against current docs. The storefront-style design is an homage to e-commerce sites: it uses no copied logos, ratings, reviews or prices (everything here is free and MIT-licensed), and this project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon.
